contexts.text: Truth is then involved in the same darkness.
Whether they involve good or truth. The words which involve good... Those which involve truth...
They involve in a few words more than a man can describe in some pages.
Hence the numeral writing involves more arcana than the literal.
The fire of the Sun... is as it were enveloped by them; and, tempered by these envelopments, becomes heat.
Unless the will and the understanding... involve themselves in works...
What the two Sacraments... involve and effect.
This involution (in a cloth) was repeated several times. He was let out, and envelope.
The dwarfs were such as had been enveloped in the linen cloth, and preserved... For when they appear to be enveloped, they envelop others by their persuasions. But the envelopment is preservation...
Being thus enveloped with such thin erg he became black...
They do not involve these things in faith Therefore they condemn as a heresy the involution and separation.
